s0101.literal: " On dingyou day of the twelfth month, the Guangzhou Gold-Silver-Pearl Directorate-General was restored, rank primary fourth grade, three officials.
s0101.idiomatic: " On dingyou day of the twelfth month, the Guangzhou Gold-Silver-Pearl Directorate-General was restored, rank primary fourth grade, 3 officials.

s0102.literal: On yisi day the Crown Prince Household Court was established, rank secondary first grade; four crown prince grand preceptors; deputy grand preceptor and grand preceptor assistant, two each; the Household Intendant Office and Yanqing Bureau, four officials each; the Treasury Bureau, eight officials.
s0102.idiomatic: On yisi day the Crown Prince Household Court was established, rank secondary first grade; 4 crown prince grand preceptors; deputy grand preceptor and grand preceptor assistant, 2 each; the Household Intendant Office and Yanqing Bureau, 4 officials each; the Treasury Bureau, 8 officials.

s0103.literal: Officials were dispatched to Xinghe Route and Jing Route to open granaries and grant relief to northern refugees.
s0103.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to Xinghe Route and Jing Route to open granaries and grant relief to northern refugees.

s0104.literal: On jiyou day patrol offices were established at Lugou Bridge, Zebian Station, and Liuli River.
s0104.idiomatic: On jiyou day patrol offices were established at Lugou Bridge, Zebian Station, and Liuli River.

s0105.literal: On renzi day a princely tutor was established for Prince of An.
s0105.idiomatic: On renzi day a princely tutor was established for Prince of An.

s0106.literal: On disi day princes Tumtemür and others and imperial son-in-law Hulawudai's followings were granted one thousand two hundred taels of gold, seven thousand seven hundred taels of silver, seventeen thousand seven hundred ingots of notes, and two thousand bolts of silks and cloths.
s0106.idiomatic: On disi day princes Tumtemür and others and imperial son-in-law Hulawudai's followings were granted 1,200 taels of gold, 7,700 taels of silver, 17,700 ingots of notes, and 2,000 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0107.literal: Palace domestic service commissioner concurrently superintending Yanfu Bureau affairs Tumder was made privy council administrator; Prince of Jin's inner secretary Atanchu was specially granted Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and Duke of Lu State.
s0107.idiomatic: Palace domestic service commissioner concurrently superintending Yanfu Bureau affairs Tumder was made privy council administrator; Prince of Jin's inner secretary Atanchu was specially granted Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and Duke of Lu State.

s0108.literal: On xinyou day the Qielian Household Craftsmen Directorate-General was changed to the Maintenance Supplies Bureau.
s0108.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Qielian Household Craftsmen Directorate-General was changed to the Maintenance Supplies Bureau.

s0109.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day princes Tumtemür and others' followings were granted forty thousand ingots of notes.
s0109.idiomatic: Fifth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day princes Tumtemür and others' followings were granted 40,000 ingots of notes.

s0110.literal: On jiaxu day Yizhou suffered an earthquake.
s0110.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yizhou suffered an earthquake.

s0111.literal: On bingzi day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched its minister Yin Shicai and others to enter tribute with local products.
s0111.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched its minister Yin Shicai and others to enter tribute with local products.

s0112.literal: On yiyou day an edict directed that commoners under princes' households in Dadu bear corvée equally with the populace.
s0112.idiomatic: On yiyou day an edict directed that commoners under princes' households in Dadu bear corvée equally with the populace.

s0113.literal: On dinghai day the metropolitan examination for jinshi candidates was held.
s0113.idiomatic: On dinghai day the metropolitan examination for jinshi candidates was held.

s0114.literal: Huguang branch secretariat pingzhang Maizhu was further made Duke of Lu State and Minister of Agriculture.
s0114.idiomatic: Huguang branch secretariat pingzhang Maizhu was further made Duke of Lu State and Minister of Agriculture.

s0115.literal: The impoverished among Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following were relieved.
s0115.idiomatic: The impoverished among Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following were relieved.

s0116.literal: Second month, on guisi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0116.idiomatic: Second month, on guisi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0118.literal: On dingyou day an edict directed: "For troops of the Guangning, Kaiyuan, and other wanhu offices entering palace guard service — where there are five brothers, sons, or nephews, three shall remain; where four or three, two shall remain; this shall be entered in the registers.
s0118.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict directed, "For troops of the Guangning, Kaiyuan, and other wanhu offices entering palace guard service — where there are 5 brothers, sons, or nephews, 3 shall remain; where 4 or 3, 2 shall remain; this shall be entered in the registers.

s0119.literal: " Qin Prefecture's Qin'an County suffered a landslide.
s0119.idiomatic: " Qin Prefecture's Qin'an County suffered a landslide.

s0120.literal: Princes Huanghuo Temür and Tumtemür were enfeoffed as Prince of Jia and Prince of Wuping respectively, and granted seals.
s0120.idiomatic: Princes Huanghuo Temür and Tumtemür were enfeoffed as Prince of Jia and Prince of Wuping respectively, and granted seals.

s0121.literal: On dingwei day an edict directed that Yunnan and Sichuan return civilian lands they had encroached upon from the Shunyuan Pacification Commission.
s0121.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict directed that Yunnan and Sichuan return civilian lands they had encroached upon from the Shunyuan Pacification Commission.

s0122.literal: On wushen day the rank of the Inner Secretariat Office was raised to primary second grade.
s0122.idiomatic: On wushen day the rank of the Inner Secretariat Office was raised to primary second grade.

s0123.literal: The Deer-Pinnacle Hall was built behind the Hall of Literary Virtue.
s0123.idiomatic: The Deer-Pinnacle Hall was built behind the Hall of Literary Virtue.

s0124.literal: On xinhai day an edict directed Hangzhou officials to sacrifice at spring and autumn to the shrine of Bayan, Loyal King of Huai'an.
s0124.idiomatic: On xinhai day an edict directed Hangzhou officials to sacrifice at spring and autumn to the shrine of Bayan, Loyal King of Huai'an.

s0125.literal: Imperial grandson Prince Dashiman's following lacked food; an edict directed the Gansu branch secretariat to grant grain for relief.
s0125.idiomatic: Imperial grandson Prince Dashiman's following lacked food; an edict directed the Gansu branch secretariat to grant grain for relief.

s0126.literal: Prince Chajir was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0126.idiomatic: Prince Chajir was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0127.literal: On jiayin day Ningchang Prefecture was established.
s0127.idiomatic: On jiayin day Ningchang Prefecture was established.

s0128.literal: On yimao day the central secretariat was ordered to eliminate non-urgent corvée, and one deputy commissioner was added to the Hedong Pacification Commission.
s0128.idiomatic: On yimao day the central secretariat was ordered to eliminate non-urgent corvée, and 1 deputy commissioner was added to the Hedong Pacification Commission.

s0129.literal: An edict directed that temples, powerful families, and merchant traffickers at the Upper Capital all pay tax levies.
s0129.idiomatic: An edict directed that temples, powerful families, and merchant traffickers at the Upper Capital all pay tax levies.

s0130.literal: On wuwu day the Jeliqiyar Myriarch Office was made the Right Guard Commandant's Office.
s0130.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Jeliqiyar Myriarch Office was made the Right Guard Commandant's Office.

s0131.literal: Three thousand taels of gold were granted for writing the Vimalakirti Sutra in Western script.
s0131.idiomatic: 3,000 taels of gold were granted for writing the Vimalakirti Sutra in Western script.

s0132.literal: On gengshen day posthumous enfeoffment was abolished.
s0132.idiomatic: On gengshen day posthumous enfeoffment was abolished.

s0133.literal: For meritorious service in suppressing the rebel prince Tuhochi, princes Chagahan and others were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks, and notes.
s0133.idiomatic: For meritorious service in suppressing the rebel prince Tuhochi, princes Chagahan and others were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks, and notes.

s0134.literal: Third month, on wuchen day the palace examination for jinshi candidates was held; Hudu Dar, Huo Xixian, and fifty others below them were granted jinshi degrees and secondary ranks in varying degrees.
s0134.idiomatic: Third month, on wuchen day the palace examination for jinshi candidates was held; Hudu Dar, Huo Xixian, and 50 others below them were granted jinshi degrees and secondary ranks in varying degrees.

s0135.literal: On jisi day Prince of Ninghai Badur was granted a gold seal.
s0135.idiomatic: On jisi day Prince of Ninghai Badur was granted a gold seal.

s0136.literal: On gengwu day the Qielian Household Directorate-General for hunting-falcon ateliers and various craftsmen under Prince Orosun's following was established, rank secondary fourth grade.
s0136.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Qielian Household Directorate-General for hunting-falcon ateliers and various craftsmen under Prince Orosun's following was established, rank secondary fourth grade.

s0137.literal: Jing'an Route was renamed De'ning Route, and Jing'an County was renamed De'ning County.
s0137.idiomatic: Jing'an Route was renamed De'ning Route, and Jing'an County was renamed De'ning County.

s0138.literal: On guiyou day Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following was impoverished; four thousand one hundred fifty shi of grain were granted for relief, and twenty thousand ingots of notes were still granted to buy cattle and sheep for breeding.
s0138.idiomatic: On guiyou day Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following was impoverished; 4,150 shi of grain were granted for relief, and 20,000 ingots of notes were still granted to buy cattle and sheep for breeding.

s0139.literal: On yihai day one additional seal was granted to the Liang-Huai Transport Commission branch office.
s0139.idiomatic: On yihai day 1 additional seal was granted to the Liang-Huai Transport Commission branch office.

s0140.literal: Prince of Anyuan Chouhan was specially granted Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, recorder of state affairs of military importance, and privy council administrator.
s0140.idiomatic: Prince of Anyuan Chouhan was specially granted Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, recorder of state affairs of military importance, and privy council administrator.

s0141.literal: On wuyin day Huzhou Route was made the fief of Prince of An Udsibuyah; the number of households was to match Prince Wei Amuge.
s0141.idiomatic: On wuyin day Huzhou Route was made the fief of Prince of An Udsibuyah; the number of households was to match Prince Wei Amuge.

s0142.literal: On guiwei day brewing liquor was forbidden in Hening and Jing routes.
s0142.idiomatic: On guiwei day brewing liquor was forbidden in Hening and Jing routes.

s0143.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes were granted, and Prince of Jin Yesun Temür was ordered to relieve the impoverished commoners of Liaodong.
s0143.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes were granted, and Prince of Jin Yesun Temür was ordered to relieve the impoverished commoners of Liaodong.

s0144.literal: Prince of Jin's inner secretary Shide Lu was further made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Duke of Huan State.
s0144.idiomatic: Prince of Jin's inner secretary Shide Lu was further made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Duke of Huan State.

s0145.literal: Nine hundred taels of gold and one hundred fifty taels of silver were granted for writing the gold-letter Scripture Canon.
s0145.idiomatic: 900 taels of gold and 150 taels of silver were granted for writing the gold-letter Scripture Canon.

s0146.literal: On jiashen day differential taxes and salt levies were remitted for those in Gongchang and other places who had received relief.
s0146.idiomatic: On jiashen day differential taxes and salt levies were remitted for those in Gongchang and other places who had received relief.

s0147.literal: On yiyou day censorate officials said: "When various offices and close attendants bypass the central secretariat in reporting to the throne, please punish them according to the former system.
s0147.idiomatic: On yiyou day censorate officials said, "When various offices and close attendants bypass the central secretariat in reporting to the throne, please punish them according to the former system.

s0149.literal: " On jichou day an edict directed that Hongcheng garrison-farm grain be used to relieve refugees at Jing Route, Pingdi, and other places.
s0149.idiomatic: " On jichou day an edict directed that Hongcheng garrison-farm grain be used to relieve refugees at Jing Route, Pingdi, and other places.

s0150.literal: Four princely tutors were established for Prince of Fenyang Betemür, and Choulu Daraqan was granted one hundred qing of land in Pingjiang Route.
s0150.idiomatic: 4 princely tutors were established for Prince of Fenyang Betemür, and Choulu Daraqan was granted 100 qing of land in Pingjiang Route.

s0151.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renchen day Prince of Anji Qitai Puji died.
s0151.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on renchen day Prince of Anji Qitai Puji died.

s0152.literal: On dingyou day Prince Yongjiladai's following lacked food; three thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
s0152.idiomatic: On dingyou day Prince Yongjiladai's following lacked food; 3,000 shi of grain were granted for relief.

s0153.literal: On jihai day Tamna hunting households Cheng Jin and others acted as bandits; an edict directed the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat to supervise troops in capturing them.
s0153.idiomatic: On jihai day Tamna hunting households Cheng Jin and others acted as bandits; an edict directed the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat to supervise troops in capturing them.

s0154.literal: On gengzi day Prince Chajir's following was granted ten thousand ingots of notes, with silks and cloths in matching amount.
s0154.idiomatic: On gengzi day Prince Chajir's following was granted 10,000 ingots of notes, with silks and cloths in matching amount.

s0155.literal: Ten thousand ingots of notes were granted for the Zhongyi Office's Yantai Shunzhou garrison-farm, to set up oxen, seed, and farm implements.
s0155.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes were granted for the Zhongyi Office's Yantai Shunzhou garrison-farm, to set up oxen, seed, and farm implements.

s0156.literal: On gengxu day an edict directed: "Of Prince of Anyuan Chouhan's fief, the seven counties subordinated to Jining and the three counties subordinated to Tingzhou — their darughachi may be appointed at his discretion.
s0156.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict directed, "Of Prince of Anyuan Chouhan's fief, the 7 counties subordinated to Jining and the 3 counties subordinated to Tingzhou — their darughachi may be appointed at his discretion.

s0157.literal: " The Scripture Printing Intendant Office was raised to the Yanfu Directorate, rank primary third grade.
s0157.idiomatic: " The Scripture Printing Intendant Office was raised to the Yanfu Directorate, rank primary third grade.

s0158.literal: Officials were dispatched to sort through refugees in each following separately and grant grain for relief.
s0158.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to sort through refugees in each following separately and grant grain for relief.

s0159.literal: The Shaanxi salt levy paid by residents of Huaimeng, Henan, and Nanyang was remitted.
s0159.idiomatic: The Shaanxi salt levy paid by residents of Huaimeng, Henan, and Nanyang was remitted.

s0160.literal: At this time the salt ponds of Jie Prefecture were damaged by water; Huaimeng and other places were ordered to consume Shaanxi red salt;
s0160.idiomatic: At this time the salt ponds of Jie Prefecture were damaged by water; Huaimeng and other places were ordered to consume Shaanxi red salt;

s0161.literal: later, because the distance was great, consumption was changed to Cang salt, yet the levy was still paid to Shaanxi; the people could not bear it — therefore it was remitted.
s0161.idiomatic: Later, because the distance was great, consumption was changed to Cang salt, yet the levy was still paid to Shaanxi; the people could not bear it — therefore it was remitted.

s0162.literal: The Mulin and Tieligan relay stations were destitute; they were supplied with five thousand horses.
s0162.idiomatic: The Mulin and Tieligan relay stations were destitute; they were supplied with 5,000 horses.

s0163.literal: Liaoyang suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of sea-transport grain were stored at Yi and Jin prefectures to relieve the impoverished commoners.
s0163.idiomatic: Liaoyang suffered famine; 100,000 shi of sea-transport grain were stored at Yi and Jin prefectures to relieve the impoverished commoners.

s0164.literal: On jiayin day privy council officials said: "When each province mobilizes and dispatches troops and horses, only two chief officials should oversee the matter.
s0164.idiomatic: On jiayin day privy council officials said, "When each province mobilizes and dispatches troops and horses, only 2 chief officials should oversee the matter.

s0165.literal: Now in Sichuan Province all officials participate — this is inconvenient; please follow the former system.
s0165.idiomatic: Now in Sichuan Province all officials participate — this is inconvenient; please follow the former system.

s0167.literal: Qiannu and Shi Bi were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat; attendant censor Jingyan was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
s0167.idiomatic: Qiannu and Shi Bi were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat; attendant censor Jingyan was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0168.literal: On wuwu day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
s0168.idiomatic: On wuwu day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

s0169.literal: Fifth month, on xinyou new moon, Shunyuan military-civilian pacification commissioner Azhe presented local products on behalf of the cave barbarian chief Heichongzi Zichang and came to audience.
s0169.idiomatic: Fifth month, on xinyou new moon, Shunyuan military-civilian pacification commissioner Azhe presented local products on behalf of the cave barbarian chief Heichongzi Zichang and came to audience.

s0170.literal: On dingmao day Prince of An Udsibuyah was granted five hundred taels of gold and five thousand taels of silver.
s0170.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince of An Udsibuyah was granted 500 taels of gold and 5,000 taels of silver.

s0171.literal: Censorate vice commissioner Yiliechi was made right chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0171.idiomatic: Censorate vice commissioner Yiliechi was made right chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0172.literal: On wuchen day associate administrator Wang Yi was dispatched to offer sacrifice to the stars at the Bureau of Astronomy for three days and nights.
s0172.idiomatic: On wuchen day associate administrator Wang Yi was dispatched to offer sacrifice to the stars at the Bureau of Astronomy for 3 days and nights.

s0173.literal: Princes Atan Temür and Buyan Temür's followings lacked food; two months' grain was granted for relief.
s0173.idiomatic: Princes Atan Temür and Buyan Temür's followings lacked food; 2 months' grain was granted for relief.

s0174.literal: On renshen day surveillance censor officials said: "In recent years titles and ranks have been recklessly bestowed; Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and State Duke follow one upon another at court.
s0174.idiomatic: On renshen day surveillance censor officials said, "In recent years titles and ranks have been recklessly bestowed; Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and State Duke follow one upon another at court.

s0175.literal: Formerly, when an edict ordered their reduction and abolition, within and without the court none were not pleased.
s0175.idiomatic: Formerly, when an edict ordered their reduction and abolition, within and without the court none were not pleased.

s0176.literal: Recently it has been heard that the Ministry of Rites, following an edict, cast twenty-six seals for Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, Grand Guardian, and the like — these men have no merit to the state, yet are recorded in the histories, inviting ridicule hereafter.
s0176.idiomatic: Recently it has been heard that the Ministry of Rites, following an edict, cast 26 seals for Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, Grand Guardian, and the like — these men have no merit to the state, yet are recorded in the histories, inviting ridicule hereafter.

s0177.literal: Please from now on retain only one or two of those whose clans are noble and whose achievements are illustrious, and abolish the rest.
s0177.idiomatic: Please from now on retain only 1 or 2 of those whose clans are noble and whose achievements are illustrious, and abolish the rest.

s0179.literal: " On guiyou day officials were dispatched by separate routes to reduce and decide crimes below beating with the rod.
s0179.idiomatic: " On guiyou day officials were dispatched by separate routes to reduce and decide crimes below beating with the rod.

s0180.literal: On jimao day Deqing Route suffered an earthquake.
s0180.idiomatic: On jimao day Deqing Route suffered an earthquake.

s0181.literal: Gongchang Longxi County suffered heavy rain; the southern earthen mountain collapsed, crushing residents to death; grain was granted for relief.
s0181.idiomatic: Gongchang Longxi County suffered heavy rain; the southern earthen mountain collapsed, crushing residents to death; grain was granted for relief.

s0182.literal: Sixth month, on xinmao day censorate officials said: "Formerly Zhang Lü and others were dispatched to administer field tax and grain in Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Henan; they falsely inflated grain quotas, poisoning the common people; an edict had already directed that collection wait three years.
s0182.idiomatic: Sixth month, on xinmao day censorate officials said, "Formerly Zhang Lü and others were dispatched to administer field tax and grain in Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Henan; they falsely inflated grain quotas, poisoning the common people; an edict had already directed that collection wait 3 years.

s0183.literal: Now the term has arrived; Jiang-Zhe and Jiangxi should pay according to precedent, but for Henan please collect at half the local rate.
s0183.idiomatic: Now the term has arrived; Jiang-Zhe and Jiangxi should pay according to precedent, but for Henan please collect at half the local rate.

s0185.literal: " On gisi day Directorate of Imperial Regalia commissioner Wochi was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, concurrently director of the Directorate of Imperial Regalia, and Grand Tutor.
s0185.idiomatic: " On gisi day Directorate of Imperial Regalia commissioner Wochi was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, concurrently director of the Directorate of Imperial Regalia, and Grand Tutor.

s0186.literal: On jihai day northern frontier garrison troops lacked food; grain was granted for relief.
s0186.idiomatic: On jihai day northern frontier garrison troops lacked food; grain was granted for relief.

s0187.literal: On gengzi day Ani Badur and Jirhai were dispatched to sort through refugees separately in the northern frontier of Jing Route; those belonging to the four palace guards and to princes and imperial sons-in-law were given provisions and sent back to their respective followings.
s0187.idiomatic: On gengzi day Ani Badur and Jirhai were dispatched to sort through refugees separately in the northern frontier of Jing Route; those belonging to the 4 palace guards and to princes and imperial sons-in-law were given provisions and sent back to their respective followings.

s0188.literal: On guimao day Prince Sanggeban was granted one gold belt, one hundred taels of silver, and five hundred ingots of notes.
s0188.idiomatic: On guimao day Prince Sanggeban was granted 1 gold belt, 100 taels of silver, and 500 ingots of notes.

s0189.literal: On yisi day the diviners Zhao Ziyu and seven others were executed.
s0189.idiomatic: On yisi day the diviners Zhao Ziyu and 7 others were executed.

s0190.literal: At that time Prince Wei Amuge had been demoted to Goryeo for a crime; Ziyu said to the princely household chief clerk Cao Tuobutai and others: "Amuge's name corresponds to a prophecy in the charts.
s0190.idiomatic: At that time Prince Wei Amuge had been demoted to Goryeo for a crime; Ziyu said to the princely household chief clerk Cao Tuobutai and others, "Amuge's name corresponds to a prophecy in the charts.

s0191.literal: " Thereupon they secretly plotted to prepare weapons, armor, and banners and drums, sail by sea to Goryeo to bring Amuge to Dadu, and wait for the moment to act; when underway at Lijin County the matter was discovered and they were executed.
s0191.idiomatic: " Thereupon they secretly plotted to prepare weapons, armor, and banners and drums, sail by sea to Goryeo to bring Amuge to Dadu, and wait for the moment to act; when underway at Lijin County the matter was discovered and they were executed.

s0192.literal: Western barbarian native bandits caused disorder; an edict directed the Gansu branch secretariat to mobilize troops to capture them.
s0192.idiomatic: Western barbarian native bandits caused disorder; an edict directed the Gansu branch secretariat to mobilize troops to capture them.

s0193.literal: On disi day Prince of An Udsibuyah and others were granted gold belts, two hundred taels of gold, one thousand fifty taels of silver, two thousand two hundred ingots of notes, and two hundred eighty bolts of silks and cloths.
s0193.idiomatic: On disi day Prince of An Udsibuyah and others were granted gold belts, 200 taels of gold, 1,050 taels of silver, 2,200 ingots of notes, and 280 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0194.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiwei new moon, Li Bangning was further made Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.
s0194.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on jiwei new moon, Li Bangning was further made Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.

s0195.literal: On guihai day princes Balidai and others were granted two hundred taels of gold, eight hundred fifty taels of silver, two thousand ingots of notes, and two hundred bolts of silks and cloths.
s0195.idiomatic: On guihai day princes Balidai and others were granted 200 taels of gold, 850 taels of silver, 2,000 ingots of notes, and 200 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0196.literal: On jiazi day one hundred forty-five thousand nine hundred ninety-two ingots of notes were granted for horse and sheep prices of the Qipchaq Guard.
s0196.idiomatic: On jiazi day 145,992 ingots of notes were granted for horse and sheep prices of the Qipchaq Guard.

s0197.literal: On bingyin day five thousand troops were mobilized to garrison-farm at Wumeng and other places; a chief wanhu office was established, rank primary third grade, and granted a silver seal.
s0197.idiomatic: On bingyin day 5,000 troops were mobilized to garrison-farm at Wumeng and other places; a chief wanhu office was established, rank primary third grade, and granted a silver seal.

s0198.literal: On dingmao day two hundred thousand ingots of notes and ten thousand shi of grain were granted, and Prince of Jin was ordered to distribute them among the palace guards of his following.
s0198.idiomatic: On dingmao day 200,000 ingots of notes and 10,000 shi of grain were granted, and Prince of Jin was ordered to distribute them among the palace guards of his following.

s0199.literal: On renshen day censorate vice commissioner Zhao Jianyan said: "The Crown Prince is in the prime of youth; it is fitting to select venerable Confucians to expound the Way and its principles.
s0199.idiomatic: On renshen day censorate vice commissioner Zhao Jianyan said, "The Crown Prince is in the prime of youth; it is fitting to select venerable Confucians to expound the Way and its principles.

s0200.literal: Now Li Quan serves as lecturer in the Eastern Palace, yet is not versed in the classics and histories; please separately seek eminent scholars to lecture and read in rotation — this would truly be boundless fortune for the altars of state.
s0200.idiomatic: Now Li Quan serves as lecturer in the Eastern Palace, yet is not versed in the classics and histories; please separately seek eminent scholars to lecture and read in rotation — this would truly be boundless fortune for the altars of state.
